purpose: Compare PI coding agent vs Evolvera: thinkingLevel, model selection, API requests handling

key_findings.pi_session_messages_source: PI's own session files (~/.pi/agent/sessions/) - buildSessionContext() rebuilds messages from JSONL entries
key_findings.pi_no_previousMessages_seed: PI NEVER seeds from external source - uses its own session storage
key_findings.evolvera_thinking_level: Hardcoded to 'medium' when creating AgentHarness (pi-backbone-agent.ts line ~575)
key_findings.evolvera_previousMessages_seed: Evolvera seeds PI session from ChatStore ONLY if session is empty (not restored from disk)

findings.relevance: PI stores user's preferred thinking level in settings.json
PI restores thinking level from session storage OR falls back to settings

findings.evidence:
const existingSession = sessionManager.buildSessionContext();
const hasExistingSession = existingSession.messages.length > 0;
findings.relevance: PI checks its own session storage for existing messages
PI restores messages from its own session storage
PI rebuilds session context from JSONL entries stored in session files
Evolvera hardcodes thinkingLevel to 'medium' when creating AgentHarness
Evolvera seeds PI session from ChatStore ONLY if session was NOT restored from disk
Evolvera also pre-loads agent memory with ChatStore history
